records.context: The region is the largest side no larger than ``side`` whose network microscope image fields fall on one grid, and the microscope image field the smallest side on the same grid that covers the region in two microscope image fields per axis with at least ``overlap_px`` of overlap, so tiled and untiled runs share every network microscope image field away from the seams (:func:`aligned_tiling`). Without such a pair the region is ``side`` and the microscope image field ``(side + overlap_px) // 2 + 1``, unaligned.

records.source: The region is the largest side no larger than ``side`` whose network tiles fall on one grid, and the tile the smallest side on the same grid that covers the region in two tiles per axis with at least ``overlap_px`` of overlap, so tiled and untiled runs share every network tile away from the seams (:func:`aligned_tiling`). Without such a pair the region is ``side`` and the tile ``(side + overlap_px) // 2 + 1``, unaligned.
records.translation: Området är den största sidan, inte större än ``side``, vars nätverksrutor faller på ett rutnät, och rutan den minsta sidan på samma rutnät som täcker området med två rutor per axel och minst ``overlap_px`` överlapp, så att körningar med och utan rutor delar varje nätverksruta bortom skarvarna (:func:`aligned_tiling`). Utan ett sådant par är området ``side`` och rutan ``(side + overlap_px) // 2 + 1``, ojusterad.

records.context: Cellpose pads an image to a multiple of 16 plus 8 px on each side and spreads ``ceil((1 + 2 * overlap) * padded / bsize)`` network tiles evenly over the padded side (``cellpose.core.run_net`` without resizing). A pixel's flows are the tapered mean of the network tiles that cover it, so two runs give a pixel the same flows only when the same network tiles, with the same pixels, cover it.

records.context: Cellpose's percentile normalisation, computed once on a whole site.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.normalize_site#0
records.source: Cellpose's percentile normalisation, computed once on a whole site.
records.translation: Cellpose:s percentilnormalisering, beräknad en gång över en hel plats.

records.context: Cellpose normalises every image it is given, so a microscope image field is scaled by its own 1st and 99th percentiles and the same pixel gets different values in two microscope image fields and in the untiled site. Here the percentiles of each image data channel come from the whole site, with the arithmetic of Cellpose's ``normalize_img`` (``normalize99`` with its subsampling; a flat image data channel becomes zeros), and every microscope image field is then segmented with ``normalize=False``. A site that fits in one microscope image field gets exactly the values Cellpose would have computed itself.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.normalize_site#1
records.source: Cellpose normalises every image it is given, so a tile is scaled by its own 1st and 99th percentiles and the same pixel gets different values in two tiles and in the untiled site. Here the percentiles of each channel come from the whole site, with the arithmetic of Cellpose's ``normalize_img`` (``normalize99`` with its subsampling; a flat channel becomes zeros), and every tile is then segmented with ``normalize=False``. A site that fits in one tile gets exactly the values Cellpose would have computed itself.
records.translation: Cellpose normaliserar varje bild den får, så en ruta skalas med sina egna 1:a och 99:e percentiler och samma pixel får olika värden i två rutor och på platsen utan rutor. Här kommer varje kanals percentiler från hela platsen, med aritmetiken i Cellpose:s ``normalize_img`` (``normalize99`` med dess delsampling; en platt kanal blir nollor), och varje ruta segmenteras sedan med ``normalize=False``. En plats som får plats i en ruta får exakt de värden som Cellpose själv skulle ha beräknat.

records.context: A microplate sample position's first site is often an empty corner of the microplate sample position, so neither the diameter nor the tiling control may come from it. A sampled site counts only when it holds at least ``min_objects`` nuclei; the diameter is the median equivalent diameter over every nucleus of those sites, clipped to ``bounds`` (:func:`estimate_nucleus_diameter`), and the control site is the one with the median nucleus count among them (the lower of the two middle sites when their number is even).

A sampled site counts only when it holds at least ``min_objects`` nuclei; the diameter is the median equivalent diameter over every nucleus of those sites, clipped to ``bounds`` (:func:`estimate_nucleus_diameter`), and the control site is the one with the median nucleus count among them (the lower of the two middle sites when their number is even).
records.translation: En brunns första plats är ofta ett tomt hörn av brunnen, så varken diametern eller rutkontrollen får komma därifrån. En urvalsplats räknas bara när den har minst ``min_objects`` kärnor; diametern är medianen av den ekvivalenta diametern över alla kärnor på dessa platser, begränsad till ``bounds`` (:func:`estimate_nucleus_diameter`), och kontrollplatsen är den med mediant antal kärnor bland dem (den mindre av de två mittersta platserna när antalet är jämnt).

records.source: Without ``align`` these are :func:`tile_grid`'s tiles. With ``align``, and when the image needs more than one tile, the tile side and step come from :func:`aligned_tiling`, and each tiled side is padded at its end so that the last tile also starts on the network grid; the stitched labels are then cut back to the image.
records.translation: Utan ``align`` är detta rutorna från :func:`tile_grid`. Med ``align``, och när bilden behöver mer än en ruta, kommer rutsida och steg från :func:`aligned_tiling`, och varje sida som delas i rutor fylls ut i slutet så att även den sista rutan börjar på nätverksrutnätet; de sammanfogade etiketterna beskärs sedan tillbaka till bilden.
